memberOptionContract.persistenceSelection: For ordinary save/load, excluding cloning, copied assets and undo/redo/abort, visitChildren visits exactly members with option bit 0x1 set. Bit 0x4 suppresses cloning, bit 0x2 allows cloning or copied assets, and bit 0x10 allows undo/redo/abort. The complete mask is retained without inferring names for the other bits.

wire.persistence: One ordinary registered value field, lexical order; no class-specific save callback registration in the member initializer
wire.constructor: Native doConstruct initializes tag to UINT32_MAX; the in-memory 0x20-byte object also has a vptr, current-version word and pointer that are not registered persisted members

limitations: The symbolic trace establishes the current schema-version-zero layout, not unobserved historical schemas
The auxiliary tag's identity domain and semantic relationship to geometric tagging remain unproven
Native in-memory offsets are not serialized offsets
No CAD code was loaded or invoked; corpus byte accounting and vendor acceptance are separate evidence
